Welcome to my Youtube Channel!
My name is Puck and I'm a 20 year old Video Maker from the Netherlands. I specialize in creating videos of my travels and experiences. I'm always looking for new and exciting places to explore and capture on camera. I also like to include a bit of fun in my videos, I am not always super serious. So come join me on my channel, and let's explore the world together! And remember, don't forget to have fun!
